data.title: OTOP Product Champion selection (การคัดเลือกสุดยอดหนึ่งตำบลหนึ่งผลิตภัณฑ์ไทย) and OTOP producer register (ทะเบียนผู้ประกอบการ OTOP)
data.author: Community Development Department (กรมการพัฒนาชุมชน), via data.go.th
data.used_for: Each district's OTOP item: rated products are linked to districts through the producer register, grouped into product types, and the most distinctive type is shown. Only product names, types and star ratings are published; producer names are not.

notes: Trees and rice paddies are generated for looks; elevation is real but averaged over 1.1 km blocks.
District items come from OTOP product data; hand-picked landmarks are shown alongside, and terrain is used only where a district has no rated OTOP products.
Province items, pixel sprites and descriptions are original to this project.
